content:
maria-support: Hey team — escalation from a Private customer: collector failed to upload a debug bundle. Customer sees API 403 on the final multipart complete and the collector shows KMS "AccessDenied" followed by connection resets. Request ID: req-2026-11-07-9a12b3c4. Need repro steps and a safe debug-bundle path (redacted) so we can hand off to infra.

support-bot: Thanks @maria-support — ticket created #SUP-4219 and retention policy set to 30d. :white_check_mark:

ajay-eng: Can you paste the small collector log snippet around the failure? Also which upload path are they using (presign -> relay -> s3)?

maria-support: Log excerpt below (sanitized):
```
2026-11-07T10:14:02Z collector[pid=3124] INFO starting debug bundle generation
2026-11-07T10:14:12Z collector[pid=3124] WARN multipart upload part failed status=403 request_id=req-2026-11-07-9a12b3c4
2026-11-07T10:14:12Z collector[pid=3124] ERROR kms:Decrypt AccessDenied key=alias/private-collector-key user=collector-role
2026-11-07T10:14:12Z collector[pid=3124] ERROR aborting multipart upload; rolling back parts
```

erin-sre: Two suspects: (1) KMS policy denies Decrypt from the collector role — confirm key policy + IAM. (2) TLS/SNI mismatch between collector -> relay (our presign broker) that returns 403 for unknown host header. Repro tip: use curl with --resolve to force SNI and check headers. Example:
```
curl -v --cert /path/to/client.crt --key /path/to/client.key -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted-token>" --resolve "relay.private.example.com:443:10.10.0.5" "https://relay.private.example.com/v1/uploads/presign?request_id=req-2026-11-07-9a12b3c4"
```

ajay-eng: Good. Also capture TLS handshake via openssl for the same endpoint:
```
openssl s_client -connect 10.10.0.5:443 -servername relay.private.example.com -showcerts
```
This will show if the cert presented doesn't match the expected CN/SAN.

maria-support: Customer is worried about PII — how do we generate the debug bundle with automatic redaction? I don't want to send emails or IPs out.

ajay-eng: Use the collector tool with a redact config. Example command to produce a redacted bundle locally:
```
collector debug-bundle create --out /tmp/dbundle.tar.gz --redact '{"redact_rules": [{"json_path": "$.user.email", "replacement": "<redacted_email>"}, {"json_path": "$.client_ip", "replacement": "<redacted_ip>"}, {"pattern": "(?i)Authorization: .*", "replacement": "Authorization: <REDACTED>"}]}' --include-logs --time-window "2026-11-07T09:50:00Z/2026-11-07T10:20:00Z"
```
Note: pass the JSON as a single string or via --redact-file to avoid shell escaping pain.

maria-support: Nice. If presign still fails, can we switch to an scp fallback over the customer's bastion?

erin-sre: Yes — use scp with a ProxyCommand and explicit IdentityFile. Example:
```
scp -o "ProxyCommand=ssh -W %h:%p -i ~/.ssh/bastion_id_rsa bastion-user@bastion.customer.example" /tmp/dbundle.tar.gz collector@10.10.0.5:/var/tmp/
```
That avoids presign/presigned PUTs entirely and preserves the redacted bundle. Make sure the customer has allowed the collector user and the target path.

ops-bot: Reminder: presigned PUTs expire in 15m by default. If multiple attempts are needed, increase expiry to 1h temporarily (set via presign_ttl in the upload profile).

ajay-eng: If we still need a curl reproduction of the failing multipart complete step, this is the minimal sequence: 1) create multipart -> get uploadId, 2) upload parts with the presigned URLs, 3) call complete-multipart with the assembled parts XML. Example complete call:
```
curl -v -X POST "https://relay.private.example.com/v1/uploads/complete?uploadId=abc123&request_id=req-2026-11-07-9a12b3c4" -H "Content-Type: application/xml" --data-binary @parts.xml --resolve "relay.private.example.com:443:10.10.0.5" --cert client.crt --key client.key
```
Include the verbose (-v) output and the full HTTP response headers in the support ticket.

maria-support: I'll ask the customer to run the curl + openssl checks and to try the scp fallback if presign stays flaky. I'll also attach the redacted bundle using scp if they approve.

erin-sre: If they can reproduce the 403 but openssl shows the cert matches, escalate to infra with the request ID + traffic dump. Likely we need to check the relay broker's host-header routing rules.

maria-support: Thanks all — I'll update ticket #SUP-4219 with the steps and next actions. Will ping again if they hand us the bundle. :v:
